open_questions: Confirm preface text (below). I wrote it from the GDD win-condition line; the GDD has no dedicated preface paragraph, so wording is mine, built on the GDD sentence.
Should the preface mention the loss at cycle win_cycle? I included it.
handoff: Preface overlay shown on launch with Start button; map processing/input disabled while open; game starts paused after Start (Space or Pause button resumes). Space ignored while preface is open. Pause works any time. Headless load clean (only sandbox noise). Not verified visually: layout, font sizes, focus on Start, Space behaviour with focused buttons.

details.preface_text:
You dream of escaping society and living on a planet of your own. But to do that, you need money.

Earn at least {win_cash} credits by the end of a cycle, within {win_cycle} cycles, and the dream comes true. If you are still short when cycle {win_cycle} ends, it slips away.

You start with {starting_credits} credits. Buy a ship, buy cheap where a good is abundant, and sell where it is scarce.
details.gdd_source: Section 1 win condition: 'Told in the beginning ... over a text menu ... dream to escape from society on its own planet ... needs money'; section 2 first 4 cycles: 'The player reads the preface story'. No P key added.
